newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kolbenschmidt plans to resume dividend payment.
newsitem.headline: Kolbenschmidt plans to resume dividend payment.

text.p: German automotive parts manufacturer Kolbenschmidt AG said on Thursday that it would resume paying a dividend in the current business year as profits and sales were expected to continue rising.

Improved industry conditions helped the group post higher first quarter results with pre-tax profits rising to 12.6 million marks from 9.4 million marks and with group sales climbing to 328 million marks from 317 million marks.
The group's business year ends on September 30.
In the business year just ended, Kolbenschmidt said its earnings per share stood at 1.60 marks, down from 1.70 marks.
Kolbenschmidt plans to resume dividend payment
The group said it expected to see moderate sales growth and plans further cost cuttings which would contribute to higher profits.
Kolbenschmidt has not paid a dividend for five years.
